overview_description.description:
We are a mobile app that simplifies bill payments for everyday people. Snap a pic & pay any bill in seconds!

We know paying bills is a stressful process for many Americans. By making it easy to pay any bill with a mobile device, we are removing the hassle of paying bills through the mail, over the phone, or on complicated web portals. We are also helping billers of all sizes and from all industries get paid faster and more often. 

We’re proud to be one of the highest-rated fintech applications on the App Store, with over 70k reviews, and backed by investors that include Sequoia Capital, Bessemer Venture Partners, and First Round Capital. 

To learn more, check out PapayaPay.com or find us on the App Store!

about_short_description.short_description: Papaya is a developer of an online mobile application and payments technology designed to simplify bill payment for consumers.

product.name: Bill Pay
product.description: A service that enables consumers to pay bills by uploading a photo of the bill or entering payment details, with funds processed through third-party financial institutions.

product.name: Embedded Bill Pay
product.description: An integrated bill payment solution embedded into partner websites or apps, allowing customers to pay bills without leaving the partner platform.

product.name: Privacy Protection Subscription
product.description: A subscription service providing identity theft monitoring, alerts, removal of exposed personal information, identity restoration, and insurance coverage.

product.name: Quickpay Widget
product.description: An online payment portal widget that enables consumers to pay bills by scanning them with a camera, without requiring an app, account, or login.

product.name: Paper Statements QR Code Payment
product.description: A payment method where consumers scan a QR code on paper statements to access a bill payment interface without needing an app or login.
